property_summary: For any caller who has previously deposited a positive amount via addToBalance(), calling withdrawBalance() causes the contract to send that exact positive amount to msg.sender (so the recipient's received value equals their prior recorded balance); the mutant that uses a literal 0 breaks this by sending 0 when the stored balance > 0.
change_summary: Replace the local temporary assignment to use a literal 0 (so zero is sent), changing observable outcome when balance > 0 (call will send 0 instead of balance).
